notes:
1.0.10
• Much lighter on Windows: a session that took 44 % of a processor core now takes 9 %
• Dropping in a sample and indexing a folder of one-shots are far quicker too
• Browser: an ARP filter, for the presets that were already tagged that way
• SUMMON hands back fewer mono and arpeggiated sounds, more you can play with both hands
• BEND shows when your host sets the wheel range itself
• Installers: three lines — VST3, standalone, factory bank — and the manual stays in the plug-in
1.0.8
• The manual is in the plug-in: menu → help → manual, sections down the left, the text on the right — the PDF is still one click away
• Both installers let you choose what goes in: leave out the standalone if you only play HALO in a DAW (Windows has a components page, macOS has Customise)
• Double-click on an effect bypasses it again, whatever look you are using
• Windows: the installer text reads correctly (it was showing mangled characters)
1.0.7
• Reverb: every preset out from under its tail — shorter SPACE decays, less amount, more DUCK; releases shortened on keys, synths, basses, arps
• INIT and SUMMON follow the same rules
• First launch: a welcome card once, the manual in the menu (help → manual), SUMMON says what it needs
• Mac: the VST3 now declares its true version (1.0.6 said 1.0.5 to hosts and to its own update check)
• Windows: the plug-in files carry their true version in their properties (they said 1.0.0)
1.0.6
• Windows: the interface opens everywhere — the WebView2 loader is built in (no more Internet Explorer page)
• Windows without WebView2: HALO says so and links the download; the installer checks every place the runtime can be
• Menus (voice, bend, mood, filters…) are drawn in the plug-in: no more notes held while one is open in FL Studio
1.0.5
• Themes: all eleven looks as tiles, plus custom
• Custom look: TRIAD, TONE, INK, FREE — dark or light plate, saved looks
• Eyedropper: pick a colour from anywhere on screen
• Update badge opens the download page
1.0.4
• Browser: ‹ › arrows step through the search or the type filter, not the whole library
1.0.3
• Pitch wheel range: follows the host (FL Studio sends it), else the new BEND setting in the footer
• BEND: 2 / 5 / 7 / 12 / 24 semitones, 12 by default
1.0.2
• Pitch wheel: fixed, all voice modes
• Mod wheel: vibrato by default, plus MOD routing
• MONO / ARP: wheels, sustain pedal, aftertouch pass through
• Windows zip: ² / ³ sound names extract correctly, 4 factory presets fixed
1.0.1
• Wave and sample pickers open in place at any window size
1.0
• RUIN: classic distortion, six circuits
• SUMMON: nine moods, far larger vocabulary
• Banks: NOVA, PARALLAX, COLOSSUS, REVERIE — 263 presets
• Wavetables: DREAM, TINE, STRAIT
• Looks: halo, stone, graphite, ember
• Full library browser: rename, tags, favourites, INIT
• Preset change clears the reverb tail; SHAPE moves without clicks
• Installers replace the factory library and tidy earlier versions
